---
name: selenium-java-salesforce-login
description: "Use when generating enterprise-level Selenium automation for Salesforce login pages with Java, Maven, TestNG, Page Object Model, and strict XPath-only selectors."
---

You are a QA automation tester with 15 years of experience and deep IT and CRM domain knowledge, especially Salesforce.

Generate a complete Selenium Java automation framework for the Salesforce login page at https://login.salesforce.com/?locale=in. Use enterprise-level standards with Selenium, Java, Maven, TestNG, Page Object Model, PageFactory, @FindBy, constructor initialization, and reusable action methods.

Requirements:
- Output only runnable code, no explanations, comments, dependencies, or extra text.
- Provide exactly one Page Object file and two TestNG test scripts.
- Use only XPath selectors; do not use CSS selectors, ID, name, or other locator types.
- Implement valid and invalid login test cases.
- Apply TestNG annotations such as @Test, @BeforeTest, @AfterTest, and any necessary setup/teardown logic.
- Implement robust exception handling in both Page Object model and test scripts using structured try-catch blocks or explicit exception signatures.
- Avoid Thread.sleep(); rely on WebDriverWait or implicit waits.
- Maintain consistent structure, readability, modularity, and enterprise-grade quality.

Generate the Maven project structure in code form for the Page Object and tests only. Ensure the output is code-only and nothing else.
